title: Canned job leaves out the fee that belongs to an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-03) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Canned job {Canned-job-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEESRC line") holds {Part-A} with part fee {Fee-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL Disposal", $5.00) and {Part-C} with part fee {Fee-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL Shop", $3.00).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has no lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of {Canned-job-A} in Title and pick the {Canned-job-A} suggestion.
  4. Click "Save & Close".
  5. Read the warning at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The new line holds {Part-C} with {Fee-B} ($3.00). Neither {Part-A} nor {Fee-A} ($5.00) is on it.
  • Step 5: One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {Part-A}. The {Fee-A} fee for {Part-A} was not added." It stays until closed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R10a, S9-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: board 6.5 shows no fee. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §5 Modified endpoints. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R10a: “When a part left out carries a fee, the fee is left out too, and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each one.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “"These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §5 Modified endpoints (apply canned line): “is the full S9-R10/R10a text ("These parts are inactive and were not added: A, B." + one "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." per fee)”
